rationale: All three lenses ran. Acceptance lens confirmed all 12 plan criteria pass. Three surviving lenses surfaced only minor findings: (1) format parameter appended unsanitized to filename (blind + edge-case; format is always a controlled enum literal from UI call sites, not user input — deferred, out of this ticket's scope); (2) trailing slash in selectedFilePath produces '' which is falsy, falling through to Content-Disposition identically to undefined — no regression, deferred; (3) UUID_PATTERN defined inside function body — minor style preference, dismissed. One additional TypeScript type concern (name: undefined in test) was refuted by the edge-case lens which confirmed Conversation.name is string | undefined. One missing else-branch test deferred as minor coverage gap. 2 dismissed, 3 deferred; 0 emitted as blocking findings.
